orders.title: MAJOR ORDER
orders.briefing: Liberate Seasse to protect the Ministry of Science expeditionary teams as they trigger the total collapse of the Void.

orders.title: STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY
orders.briefing: Complete all designated planetary objectives in order to catalyze research into the effect of Void Blossoms, enable the synthesis of a chemical countermeasure, and aid the liberation of the Void source planet, Seasse.
